metadata.attribution: Road geometry: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (HOT extract embedded in supplied GeoPackage). Representational water assets and hazards are separate project layers.
metadata.distanceModel: Haversine, mean Earth radius 6371008.8m; no elevation adjustment
metadata.graphHashDefinition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON of {schema,nodes,edges}; sorted object keys, compact separators, literal Unicode; excludes metadata
limitations: OpenStreetMap completeness, age, vehicle permissions, bridges, road condition and current traffic are unverified.
All supplied one-way values are missing: bidirectional inference is a modelling assumption, not legal travel permission.
Only tertiary, residential, unclassified, service and livingstreet/living_street types support the road profile. Footway, path and pedestrian types are excluded.

Un-noded crossings and endpoints near but not equal remain disconnected. A bridge endpoint shared with a ground vertex is assumed to be a ramp junction, including the source bridge tagged layer -1. Missing or inconsistent bridge/layer values can conceal real grade separation.
Geometric endpoint-to-road snapping is at most 250m; gaps above 50m are prominently warned. Connectors are unverified and excluded from routed distance and ETA; canals may prevent access.
Distances are approximate surface lengths; speed and road-type caps are assumptions. No flood-safe, drinking-water-safe or validated traffic ETA claim follows.
metadata.topology: Equal coordinates rounded to 8 decimal degrees join at shared source vertices with equal (layer,bridge) grade. Different grades join at two original LineString endpoints, or a bridge endpoint and a shared ground (layer 0) vertex (assumed ramp). Bridge interiors, un-noded geometric crossings and nearby endpoints do not acquire connections.
